parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies and along which way, and signing off a flight before it leaves. I can also call off a flight. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and the same popular drones. Software never chooses a drone or a way for us, but I do want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts.
